sourceTitle: A Voyage in the 'Sunbeam', Our Home on the Ocean for Eleven Months
description: "A Voyage in the 'Sunbeam', Our Home on the Ocean for Eleven Months" by Annie Brassey is a travelogue written in the late 19th century. This work chronicles the author's maritime adventures aboard the yacht 'Sunbeam', as she embarks on a grand voyage around the world alongside her family and companions.
